title: Independent witnesses to the log's head: monotonic, linked, verified against a trust root
note: Assurance E (D-2026-170). Each mutation deletes one rule of the witness (rollback, fork, the proof's hashing, numbering, length, linking and end, persist-before-answer, no trust on first use, provisioning) or of the verifier (signatures, origin, truncation, fork, quorum, distinct witnesses, staleness, the trust root's log, the signed time). tests/test_witness.py holds each with a control. WT24 to WT44 (AUD-049): what the witness and the verifier are handed that is not what they read. A proof record that cannot be hashed, or links to what is not a string, is the witness's own refusal; a cosignature is held to its shape however it was built, and its record and its checkpoint's to their keys; what is not a head cosignature is a note. No test held the record forms before. WT45 to WT53: rules of the protocol that had no mutation: a witness the trust root does not name, records beside the witnessed head, one state file under two names, what names a log and a witness, an empty log, and a quorum larger than the trust root. All but the first and the last had no test either.
